name: cache-saver
description: When an idle session's prompt cache is about to expire, summarizes it while the cache is still warm; when you come back, pick A (keep the full session, pay the cache write) or B (continue from the summary).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Summarize idle sessions before the cache expires and offer the A/B choice.

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: auto reads it from the session transcript; 5m or 1h forces it.

leadSeconds.title: Summarize at (seconds left)
leadSeconds.description: How long before the idle cache expires to summarize the session over it.

minTokens.title: Minimum session size (tokens)
minTokens.description: Smaller sessions are cheap to re-cache, so no summary is offered.
